items.name: Brass knuckles
items.description:
**Properties:**
- **Dual-Wielding:** This weapon is designed to be wielded in concert with another weapon. When wielding another weapon in your main hand that does not have the heavy property, you can use your bonus action to make an attack with this weapon (see Two-Weapon Fighting on page 446 in Chapter 8: Combat).
- **Hand-Mounted:** This weapon is affixed to your hand. You can do simple activities such as climbing a ladder while wielding this weapon, and you have advantage on saving throws made to resist being disarmed. You cannot use a hand that is wielding a hand-mounted weapon to do complex tasks like picking a pocket, using thieves' tools to bypass a lock, or casting spells with seen components.

items.name: Sword pistol
items.description:
When this weapon is used to hit a target with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction to fire the gun in the handle, gaining a 1d6 expertise die on an immediate ranged weapon attack against the same target.

Rare Ranged Weapons Ranged rare weapons require ammunition to use, although some firearms can hold multiple bullets at a time.

**Properties:**
- **Finesse:** You may choose to use your Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
- **Loading:** This weapon must be loaded before it can be used. You may only make one attack with a loading weapon when you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
- **Range:** This weapon fires ammunition. The range lists two numbers after it, both measured in feet—the first is the weapon's normal range, and the second is the weapon's maximum range. You have disadvantage on attack rolls made beyond the weapon's normal range, and you cannot make attacks against targets beyond the weapon's maximum range.

items.name: Spiked chain
items.notes: Heavy, parrying immunity, reach (10 ft.), two-handed
items.description:
**Properties:**
- **Heavy:** Heavy shields increase your Armor Class by 2 and you gain an expertise die on Dexterity saving throws. When you take the Dodge action while wielding a heavy shield, you may instead take cover behind your shield, gaining an expertise die to your Armor Class until the start of your turn. You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wielding a heavy shield, and you cannot squeeze through spaces smaller than your size category.
- **Parrying Immunity:** Attacks with this weapon ignore the parrying property and Armor Class bonuses from shields.
- **Reach:** This weapon can be used to make attacks against targets within 10 feet. If a weapon has a longer reach, it is stated in parentheses after this property.
- **Two-Handed:** You must use two hands to wield this weapon.

items.name: Mercurial maul
items.description:
The liquid metal inside of the shaft and head of this weapon makes it difficult to wield but all the deadlier in expert hands. The minimum result on a damage die rolled with this weapon is a 2.

**Properties:**
- **Breaker:** This weapon deals double damage to unattended objects, such as doors and walls. If this property only applies to a specific type of material, such as wood, it is stated in parentheses after this property.
- **Heavy:** Heavy shields increase your Armor Class by 2 and you gain an expertise die on Dexterity saving throws. When you take the Dodge action while wielding a heavy shield, you may instead take cover behind your shield, gaining an expertise die to your Armor Class until the start of your turn. You have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks while wielding a heavy shield, and you cannot squeeze through spaces smaller than your size category.
- **Two-Handed:** You must use two hands to wield this weapon.

items.name: Shotgun
items.notes: Loading, range (30/90); crit if both dice hit on advantage
items.description:
When this weapon is used to make an attack roll with advantage, the attack becomes a critical hit if both d20 rolls would result in a hit. When this weapon is used to make an attack roll with disadvantage and only one attack roll would result in a hit, you instead deal 1d4 piercing damage (adding no bonuses to damage from ability score modifiers or enchantments)

items.name: Ratcheting crossbow
items.description:
This crossbow has a large winding wheel affixed to its drawstring which feeds into extra machinery along the stock that catches and pulls the string back again after it is fired. Winding a ratcheting crossbow for a single bolt requires a bonus action or action, and it can be wound to prepare two bolts. Masterwork ratcheting crossbows can be prepared to fire up to four bolts, or be constructed smaller (with statistics like a hand crossbow).
